rules.title: Give an angle
rules.tag: Help the player on the ball find a pass.
rules.summary: Move to a clear space where your teammate can see you.
rules.extra: Try the picture in a game. Players can choose a different solution when the situation changes.

rules.title: One goes, one covers
rules.tag: Do not all chase the same opponent.

rules.title: Recover together
rules.tag: Help our team when the ball changes hands.

rules.extra: Try the picture in a game. Players can choose a different solution when the situation changes.

roles.title: Goalkeeper
roles.head: Start us playing
roles.src: Provisional How We Play Football coaching research, 26 October 2026; David Wilson review pending
points: Choose a safe pass and be ready to help again.
Look up before releasing the ball.

roles.title: Defender
roles.head: Protect and connect
roles.src: Provisional How We Play Football coaching research, 26 October 2026; David Wilson review pending
points: Offer the goalkeeper a passing option.
Look for one of the wider teammates.
Protect the route to our goal when the ball is lost.

roles.title: Wide players
roles.head: Find room on either side
roles.src: Provisional How We Play Football coaching research, 26 October 2026; David Wilson review pending
points: Move apart enough to show passing angles.
Sometimes dribble, sometimes pass, sometimes recover.
Help the defender if the opposition attack.

roles.title: Forward
roles.head: Give us somewhere ahead
roles.src: Provisional How We Play Football coaching research, 26 October 2026; David Wilson review pending
points: Offer a forward pass without standing still.
Try moving towards the ball or into space.
Help slow the opposition when we lose it.
roles.cue: Do we need a short pass or a run?

issue.intro: Four outfield players and a goalkeeper. The diamond is a starting picture that helps children find a passing option, spread out and learn to recover together. Let everyone try different roles.
issue.summary: The 5v5 1-2-1: starting shape, four playing principles, player roles and how the team plays together.
